premises.text: Whole-field fertilizer rates waste inputs and yield globally
premises.evidence_span: This results in huge inefficiency, up to $100,000 for an average Australian cotton farm

premises.text: IR/satellite nitrogen maps plus farm data yield variable-rate prescriptions
premises.evidence_span: so that fertilizer can go only where it's needed exactly when it's required

premises.text: Hyperspectral sensing sees stress sooner and identifies the stressor
premises.evidence_span: Our hyperspectral sensing is allowing farmers to see the crop stress sooner

premises.text: Guided sampling, calibration, analytics, and zoning operationalize the maps
premises.evidence_span: To enact on this chosen fertilizer strategy, the agronomist now uses the zoning tool

premises.text: Sold as annual per-hectare subscriptions via agronomy firm channels
premises.evidence_span: multiple agronomy firms, which are including world's largest, which are our channels to market

value.text: Farmers apply fertilizer precisely to grow more with less

notes: Single-domain mechanism from problem through channel.
